run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T00:47:06Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by a checkout outage. frontend-proxy's own error-span rate was ~0.003-0.004/s up to 00:48:06 and jumped to ~1.50/s by 00:53:06, and its access logs show 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' (i.e. the 500 is returned by the frontend upstream, not generated by Envoy) from 00:48:18 through at least 00:55:59. The frontend's error spans in the window are concentrated on POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect, while its calls to cart, ad and product-catalog recorded zero errors. The checkout Deployment in otel-demo had its pod template image changed to the malformed string "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" (literal newline); the new ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 was created at 00:47:13, its only pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 is Pending with container state waiting reason InvalidImageName ('invalid reference format'), and the checkout Service has no ready endpoint addresses. The Deployment reports MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 00:47:23. All other otel-demo pods are Running/ready with 1/1 available replicas, and the flagd feature flags are all 'off', so neither a broader platform failure nor a feature-flag fault explains the errors. The actor that applied the bad image is unknown (no change-history integration, webhook configs unreadable), and the alert rule itself is not present in this Prometheus, so several details remain unverified (see gaps).

claims.text: frontend-proxy's error-span rate (traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy"}) was ~0.0037-0.0043/s at 00:28:06-00:48:06, rose to 0.285/s at 00:49:06 and peaked at ~1.50/s at 00:53:06, while its unset-status span rate stayed ~20-26/s, so this is a new error signal rather than a traffic change.

Over 23:47:06-01:08:01 the frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans are concentrated on POST /api/checkout (361.23), executing api route (pages) /api/checkout (361.34), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (361.34) and tcp.connect (19.34); its other operations (GET, GET/POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, /api/data route, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, CartService/AddItem, CartService/GetCart) show 0 error spans.

frontend-proxy access logs show 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' (upstream = frontend) starting at 2026-11-18T00:48:18.968Z and continuing at 00:48:19, 00:48:23, 00:48:30-00:48:39, and again at 00:55:58-00:55:59, while other routes in the same lines returned 200/308.

The otel-demo Deployment 'checkout' has container image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" in its pod template (all other env vars are the standard demo values), with status replicas=1, updatedReplicas=1, unavailableReplicas=1, observedGeneration=4, condition Available=False reason=MinimumReplicasUnavailable lastTransitionTime 2026-11-18T00:47:23Z.

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 is Pending, owned by ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99, with container 'checkout' not started, restartCount 0, state waiting reason InvalidImageName and message "Failed to apply default image tag \"quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\\n:1.0.0\": couldn't parse image name \"quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\\n:1.0.0\": invalid reference format".

The otel-demo Service endpoints for 'checkout' have no ready addresses (ips empty) and only notReadyAddresses 100.96.4.211 on port 8080, whereas endpoints for 'frontend' (100.96.4.149) and 'frontend-proxy' (100.96.4.165) each have a ready address on port 8080.

Among the 21 otel-demo pods, only checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 is not Running/ready (Pending, ready=false, waiting InvalidImageName); every other pod (including frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-t9gll) is Running with ready=true. Among the 21 otel-demo Deployments, only 'checkout' lacks available/ready replicas; all others report availableReplicas=1 and readyReplicas=1.

ReplicaSets show a checkout rollout with a bad image: checkout-5dccddf8bb (owner checkout, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, created 2026-11-18T00:09:08Z) is scaled to replicas=0, while checkout-d75b77f99 (owner checkout, image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0", created 2026-11-18T00:47:13Z) is at replicas=1 with no ready/available replicas.

otel-demo events record the rollout: Deployment checkout ScalingReplicaSet scaled checkout-d75b77f99 up from 0 to 1 and scaled checkout-5dccddf8bb down from 1 to 0 at 00:47:16-00:47:23, pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq was Killed ('Stopping container checkout') at 00:47:16, and pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 produced InspectFailed (27x) and Failed (12x) with message 'Error: InvalidImageName' / 'Failed to apply default image tag ... invalid reference format'.

checkout service span activity collapsed at the rollout: its 5-minute span rate fell from ~9.6/s (steady to 00:48:06) to 6.99/s at 00:49:06, 5.12/s at 00:50:06, 3.38/s at 00:51:06, 1.84/s at 00:52:06 and 0 from 00:53:06 onward, consistent with the last pod terminating at ~00:47:42.

Across all namespaces only three Deployments reference quay.io/it-bench images: opentelemetry-collectors/kubernetes-events-collector and opentelemetry-collectors/kubernetes-objects-snapshot-collector (quay.io/it-bench/opentelemetry-collector:1.0.0), and otel-demo/checkout ('quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0', helm release otel-demo, deployment revision 2, generation 4).

The flagd-config ConfigMap (otel-demo) defines fault-injection flags (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) but every one has defaultVariant "off" and no checkout-related flag exists; only metrics with label service_name="frontend-proxy" in this Prometheus are traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket.

The span-metric series that carry frontend-proxy sampling stop being reported around 00:58:00: a 2-minute rate query over 00:54:00-01:08:01 returns points only up to 00:58:00 (error 0.856-0.944/s, unset 8.9-15.2/s), and an instant query at 01:07:36 returns nothing.

The frontend's other dependency paths were not failing: its client spans to CartService/AddItem, CartService/GetCart, AdService/GetAds, ProductCatalogService/* and RecommendationService/ListRecommendations, and its /api/cart, /api/data and page GET routes, recorded 0 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans over the whole 79-minute window, so the frontend failure is not a broad frontend or shared-dependency failure.

A feature-flag fault is not supported: every flag in flagd-config has defaultVariant "off" and there is no checkout flag, and only the otel-demo/checkout Deployment carries the malformed it-bench image while all other otel-demo Deployments keep ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-* images and report 1/1 available replicas.

frontend-proxy itself being the faulty component is rejected as the cause: its 500 responses are logged with the upstream field showing 'via_upstream' and the upstream service listed as frontend, and its ingress and 'router frontend egress' spans mirror the frontend's /api/checkout errors rather than showing a local proxy or routing fault.

Causal chain supported by the observations: the checkout Deployment pod template was replaced with the malformed image at ~00:47:13, its only pod cannot start (InvalidImageName), the checkout Service loses all ready endpoints, the frontend's CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls fail, the frontend returns 500 for POST /api/checkout, frontend-proxy relays those 500s as ingress errors, and RequestErrorRate fires. The exact error text of the failed gRPC calls (e.g. connection refused) is not observed because no incident-window traces were available.

Restore the checkout Deployment's container image to ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout (the image the previous ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb used) and roll it out, then confirm the pod becomes Ready, the checkout endpoints repopulate and POST /api/checkout returns 200.

Find the tool or controller that wrote the image value: the string contains a literal newline ('quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0'), which points to a templating/quoting defect in whatever applied the change, and review the mutating admission webhooks and deployment-mutation tooling for it.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not present in this Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and with type=alert match {severity="warning"} both returned nothing, so the alert expression, the reported value 2.0444444444444443 and which metric produced it could not be verified.

No http_*/rpc_* metric families were returned by get_metric_names for {__name__=~"http_.*|rpc_.*"}, and get_series for {__name__="http_server_request_duration_seconds_count"} returned nothing in 00:47:06-01:08:01, so HTTP status-code level request/error counts for frontend-proxy are not established in this Prometheus.

Who or what changed the checkout Deployment image is unknown: the change_history integration is not available in this Run, and mutatingwebhookconfigurations could not be read (repeated SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), so an image-mutating admission webhook or external deployment mutator cannot be ruled out or confirmed.

Jaeger returned no traces for the incident window: traces_search for frontend in 00:49:00-00:53:00 returned nothing and the only frontend traces returned covered 00:35:08-00:35:09, so the gRPC status code and error detail of the failing CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls (and the tcp.connect errors) could not be read.

The frontend pod's logs for 00:47:00-00:59:00 returned no lines (lines_read 0 for container frontend in frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589), so the frontend's own error text for the /api/checkout 500s is unverified.

The span-metric series for frontend-proxy stop around 00:58:00 (no points after 00:58:00 in a 00:54-01:08 query and none at 01:07:36), so whether the elevated error rate persisted until the alert window end is unknown; the falling 5-minute rates near 01:01 reflect the series ending, not an observed recovery.

The alert's stated start 2026-11-18T00:47:06Z precedes the first observed 500 line (00:48:18.968Z), the checkout pod kill (00:47:16Z) and the code metrics' error-rate rise (between 00:48:06 and 00:49:06); the sequence in that ~70-second interval is unresolved.

For currency, email, image-provider, quote and shipping no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series were returned in the by-service breakdown (and for product-catalog/recommendation only small background counts appeared for ad/fraud-detection/recommendation), so their error state is not established beyond their Deployment/pod object status being available/Ready.
next_steps: Roll back the checkout Deployment image to ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and confirm pod Ready plus repopulated checkout endpoints.
Audit the deployment-mutation tooling / admission webhooks that produced the string with a literal newline in the checkout image field.
Locate the source of the RequestErrorRate alerting rule outside this Prometheus (it is not loaded here) to confirm the metric and threshold behind 'current: 2.0444444444444443'.
Re-check frontend-proxy error rate and checkout endpoint readiness once span-metric collection resumes, since collection stopped around 00:58.

view.series_note: traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans of every operation of the service (internal, client and server spans alike), summed over the labels kept in this query; it is not a count of requests. status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET means the span carried no status; it does not mean the call succeeded.
